heading: Access for {client}
body: {client} asks for read-only access to the graphs of {login}: topologies, routes and events. It cannot change or upload anything.
where_listed: The access appears in Access → API tokens as "{client} (sign-in)" for 30 days, where it can be revoked.
invalid_text: The sign-in address is outdated or was changed. Start the sign-in again from the terminal: codex mcp login topolograph for Codex or /mcp in Claude Code.
error_failed: The sign-in request could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
error_decision: The decision was not sent. Try again.
